question: In the Curse of Strahd introductory adventure (Death House), what object is found inside the small wooden coffer in the prison area (Area 36)?

vector_naive.answer: A dire wolf's withered tongue. Source: Death House appendix of Curse of Strahd.
search_queries: Death House prison Area 36 wooden coffer contents

vector_2round.answer: A dire wolf's withered tongue. Source: Death House (Appendix B), page 11.

hybrid_free.answer: A dire wolf's withered tongue, found in Area 35 (Reliquary). Area 36 (Prison) contains a skeleton with a gold ring (25 gp). Source: Curse of Strahd Introductory Adventure.pdf p.11.
